[Image: Points on a coordinate plane]

In the coordinate plane above, which point could have coordinates (2,−4)?
figure_description: A Cartesian coordinate plane with horizontal axis x and vertical axis y intersecting at origin O, each axis marked with arrows at both ends. Four points are plotted and labeled: point P in the second quadrant (upper left), point Q in the first quadrant (upper right), point S in the third quadrant (lower left), and point R in the fourth quadrant (lower right).
